rationale.reteach: Reteach from the paired notes trap: One mole of anything weighs the same.. The slip: A mole feels like a fixed bag of the same size, so every mole feels equally heavy. The fix: Mass = moles x molar mass: one mole of hydrogen is 1 g but one mole of oxygen is 16 g. A mole fixes the count of particles - the molar mass decides how heavy that count is.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
